title: Jenkins Shared Library - Gitlab CI migration
description: Designed and developed curated Jenkins shared library/pipelines in Groovy for organization wide application teams with support for multiple languages including Java, JavaScript (Node) and Python. Mimicked Gitlab CI/CD including Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.

title: Scholar Hub - Research Opportunities Platform
description: Comprehensive full-stack web application that helps researchers discover and manage funding opportunities including grants and scholarships. Features personalized AI-powered recommendations, user authentication via Supabase, advanced filtering and search capabilities, bookmark management, and application tracking. Built with React frontend, Flask backend, Docker, and deployed on AWS ECS/Fargate with CloudFront and Route 53.

title: Three Tier Application - Project A
description: Architected and deployed a scalable 3-tier web application demonstrating modern cloud-native patterns. Frontend built with Astro and React Islands, served via S3/CloudFront. Backend with Express.js on Nginx, containerized using Docker and deployed to AWS ECS Fargate with OIDC GitHub CI/CD. Automated infra provisioning using AWS CloudFormation.

title: Project B - Fullstack with Kubernetes & GitOps
description: Full-stack application paired with Kubernetes cluster and monitoring solution. Utilized GitOps practices with a separate repo for source-of-truth cluster configs and monitoring setup.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Personal portfolio website showcasing projects and experience. Built with Astro and React, styled with TailwindCSS, and deployed on modern hosting platforms.

title: GitHub to Claude AI
description: Browser extension to upload GitHub repositories directly to Claude AI for analysis and interaction.
